output.reason: [ev-f2e613944dc4] says that environments installed and managed with Cilium CLI in classic installation mode are exposed. Classic mode is not supported with v1.16, and moving to Helm mode means uninstalling and reinstalling. The proposed condition gets the version range backwards: "out-of-range" of "<0.15.0" matches CLI versions 0.15.0 and later, which are the safe ones. It also requires a cilium.io/v1 CiliumInstallation resource that the evidence never mentions. Neither the CLI version nor the installation mode shows up in Helm values or manifests, so exposure has to be undecidable.

correction.statement: Cilium v1.16 does not support Cilium CLI classic installation mode. Classic-mode installations must be uninstalled with the classic-mode CLI and reinstalled with Cilium CLI v0.15.0 or later in Helm mode. Exposure depends on how Cilium was installed and managed, which static inputs do not show.

exposure.needed: whether Cilium was installed and is managed with Cilium CLI in classic installation mode (e.g. a CLI older than v0.15.0 or a CLI explicitly set to classic mode) rather than Helm mode
